description: Declarative billing pair seed definitions for Shutoko C1 real fixture

provenance.notes: Verified 1-section-ahead adjacency on C1 outer loop from Kandabashi entry to Takaracho exit (Gofukubashi and Edobashi exits decommissioned in 2021). Tariff sources (verified 2026-09-10): fee structure and minimum toll (https://www.shutoko.jp/fee/fee-info/about/); Kandabashi to Takaracho toll distance 1.7km with minimum toll 300 yen applied (https://www.shutoko.jp/-/media/pdf/responsive/customer/fee/fee-info/2504_pamphlet_fee_table.pdf); 2026-10-01 tariff revision maintaining 300 yen minimum toll (https://www.shutoko.co.jp/company/press/2026/data/07/31-toll/).
